title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: The B‑17G has landed! (+ new C‑32 & liveries)
description:
🔍 Description
The week of January 29, 2026 brings another exciting Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update, and this week is packed with some absolute must‑have aircraft for PC simmers. From the iconic B‑17G to the sleek C‑32 and the unique Colditz Cock, there’s something here for every flying style.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Microprose: B‑17G (Iconic WWII heavy bomber)
🛫 mscenery: C‑32 Professional (Modernized VIP transport variant)
🛫 Rara-Avis Sims: Colditz Cock (Historic WWII escape glider)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: 767‑300ER GE Livery Pack 10
🎨 Captain Sim: 767‑300ER GE Livery Pack 11
🎨 Captain Sim: 767‑300ER GE Livery Pack 12
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200ER RR Livery Pack 21
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200ER RR Livery Pack 28
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200ER RR Livery Pack 34

If you enjoyed this week’s breakdown, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for more MSFS content, and drop a comment telling me which aircraft you’ll be flying first!
Thanks for watching and ✈️ see you in the skies!
